REQS so far (core.py implements):
S1: export_records(records,user,params)->CSV header id,title,owner,amount via csv.writer lineterminator \n, asc id; viewer->PermissionError; admin all projects else project in user.projects; only active unless include_archived is True; don't modify input; ignore unknown params.
S2: confidential excluded unless admin and purpose=='audit'; since 'YYYY-MM-DD' keep created>=since; OBLIGATION: if format changes from CSV, include top-level 'exported_by'=user['name'] unless withdrawn.
S3 CHANGED format: json.dumps({"exported_by":name,"records":[{id int,title,owner,amount str}]}) asc id; CSV rule replaced.
S4 CHANGED perms: non-admin also gets records with owner==user[name] even outside projects (viewer still PermissionError).
Status: stages 1-4 implemented (core.py: _filter + export_records).

## Changes

- [NEW] Record limit: params may contain 'max_records', an int of at least 1. Export only the first max_records records (in ascending id order) that remain after every other rule. The JSON object must also have the key "truncated": true if this limit left out at least one record, otherwise false (also when max_records is absent).
